response.rationale: Both answers fit the narrowed sense “local residential area.” Indonesian lingkungan is a standard neighborhood/local-area term, while Malaysian Malay kawasan kejiranan is a well-attested residential-neighborhood expression. The contrast is a legitimate variety preference, not a false-friend distinction.
